description: This file defines the PdfResources class in the PdfSharp library, responsible for managing PDF resource dictionaries such as fonts, images, forms, graphics states, patterns, shadings, and properties. It provides methods to add various resource types and generates unique resource names, maintaining mappings between resources and their local names within PDF documents.

classes.name: PdfResources
classes.description: Represents a PDF resource object, managing mappings for fonts, images, forms, graphics states, patterns, shadings, and properties within a PDF document.

classes.name: PdfResources.Keys
classes.description: Defines the set of keys used within the PdfResources dictionary, such as /Font, /XObject, /ExtGState, etc.

methods.name: AddFont
methods.description: Adds a PdfFont resource to the dictionary and returns its local resource name.

methods.name: AddImage
methods.description: Adds a PdfImage resource to the dictionary and returns its local resource name.

methods.name: AddForm
methods.description: Adds a PdfFormXObject resource to the dictionary and returns its local resource name.

methods.name: AddExtGState
methods.description: Adds a PdfExtGState resource to the dictionary and returns its local resource name.

methods.name: AddPattern
methods.description: Adds a pattern resource (either PdfShadingPattern or PdfTilingPattern) to the dictionary and returns its local resource name.

methods.name: AddShading
methods.description: Adds a PdfShading resource to the dictionary and returns its local resource name.
